subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: After the correctness blockers are repaired, should yielded-parent waiting become a permanent public `deferred` cron, protocol, hook, CLI, UI, and plugin SDK status?
rationale: The internal lifecycle bug can be fixed without committing persisted state and downstream consumers to a new permanent lifecycle value, so tests alone cannot authorize this product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Preserve existing public status values and use yielded-waiting only inside runtime lifecycle and reconciliation code.

options.title: Approve public deferred
options.body: Retain the new status only after explicit fresh-install, upgrade, persistence, and downstream-consumer compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Keep waiting internal
recommendation.body: Preserve existing public status values and use yielded-waiting only inside runtime lifecycle and reconciliation code.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing review and feature-history routing make this the best available owner for the product-level lifecycle contract decision.
